warnings: This document is a brochure explaining the New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (LAD) and the Division on Civil Rights' enforcement procedures. It covers housing discrimination based on protected classes (race, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, ancestry, disability, nationality, affectional/sexual orientation, familial status, domestic partner status) and source of lawful income. It does not address any of the six rental-housing law categories in scope: rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application/screening fees, screening restrictions (beyond source-of-income discrimination), or algorithmic rent setting. The source is an administrative/procedural guide rather than substantive rental housing regulation.
